name: Rosemary Butter Steak
description: adaptable for multiple cuts of steak.
steps: Take steak out of fridge and add salt and pepper on all sides.
Crush garlic cloves, mince for more garlic flavor.
Remove rosemary off of 1 twig, leave other for later.
Set heat to med/high and add pan at least twice as large as steak for 3 mins. for cast iron heat for 5 to 7 mins.
Mix herbs (not the second twig of rosemary) and melted butter in a small bowl
Add olive oil and steak to pan on one side
Add the butter mixture to the other side of the pan
As steak cooks on each side spoon over butter mixture.
When finished cooking on both sides remove from heat and brush butter over using second rosemary twig.
Allow steak to rest with rosemary on top.

name: Air fryer garlic herb salmon
steps: Microwave butter in small bowl for 5 to 10 seconds
Combine and mix butter garlic basil
Salt and pepper all sides of salmon
Add salmon and pour over butter mixture and place lemon on top
Squeeze remaining lemon from top of salmon and discard it
